newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Konecranes 4-mth profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Konecranes 4-mth profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 46.5 million markka median forecast for industrial cranes maker KCI Konecranes International Oy's January-April profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
(Profit forecasts by 10 analysts, EPS by seven analysts).
Konecranes' four-month results are due on May 29 at 1000/0700 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Konecranes posted a 36.2 million markka profit.
In February, Konecranes said it expected growth in all business areas and a favourable trend in margins.

The median of eight analysts' forecasts for Konecranes' full-year 1997 profit was 250 million markka (mean 246 million) in a 230-257 million markka range. Konecranes' 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax was 208.2 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, AG Securities, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Fim Securities, Interbank, Merita and Handelsbanken.
